title: FlaggedQuery
description: Captured query that hit RED, block_with_redirect, insufficient_evidence, or A6 verifier failure. Used for content gap analysis and safety review.

queryTextRedacted.description: Redacted query text per ADR 0005. Raw text lives only in raw_sensitive_log when the row is sensitive.

rawSensitiveLogId.description: FK to encrypted raw_sensitive_log row when sensitive; admin-only, audited, 30-day retention.

embedding.description: Optional flagged-query embedding for clustering. Vector dimension matches the active embedding model.
